label: K sense: a CONTINGENT_1 actual being excludes actual modal collapse, by the K collapse law
meaning: Frame class K (no frame condition). By the verified K collapse law (MODAL-K-LAWS), full collapse at w on the route's frame holds exactly when every world accessible from w is w. The node gives an accessible world lacking its witness; under collapse that world is w, where the witness exists. So the route's world is not collapsed. Without the node collapse holds (one-world frame). Reconciled interface: closed modal laws and correspondence certificates are imported and applied as verified theorems, not retained as assumptions; only the displayed node and frame schemas remain premises.
